decisions.rationale: Initial exploration targeting diverse values across major sites s1, s3, and s5 to establish baseline effects relative to the default.
Test combinations of s1=A (which showed lowest f1) and s3=C (low f2) to balance costs, exploring s2 and s5 variations.
s1=D and s1=E achieve strong f2. Combining s1=D/E with components from s1=A (s3=A, s2=A) may balance f1 and f2, exploring non-dominated trade-offs.
s2=B dramatically lowers f2, especially with s1=D and s1=E. Combining s1=D or E with s2=B and s3=A (which yields low f1) should explore high-quality compromises on the Pareto front.
s2=B with s4=A yields low f2, while s1=D/A and s3=A minimize f1. Testing s1=A/B with s2=B and s4=A targets intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Testing s2=B combined with s4=A and s3=B/E to discover low f2 values while varying s1 across promising candidates (A, B, E) to probe unseen combinations.
Test s2=B combined with s4=A and s3=D on unexplored or promising s1/s5 choices to push f2 lower, and test s1=D/B with s3=B/E and s2=A to explore intermediate trade-offs.
Investigate s1=B with s2=B and s3=B/E which offer low f2 while maintaining relatively low f1. Also test s4=A on low f1 configurations (s3=A) with s2=A to explore intermediate trade-offs.
Testing s1=C with s3=D/B/C and s4=A to observe f2 and trade-offs, since s1=C ignores s2 and might offer lower costs between extreme Pareto modes.
Explores s1=C with s3=E to potentially improve f1 at low f2 (around 2880), tests s1=C with s3=A,s4=B for low f1, and tests s1=A with s3=B/E at s2=A.
Explore varied labels across all sites starting from orthogonal alternatives to map sensitivity relative to the baseline.
Config 3 achieved very low f1 with s3=C and s5=B. Pairing low-f1 features (s1=B, s3=C) with low-f2 parameters (s3=B, s5=D) explores trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Evaluating combinations targeting the extreme low f1 (s1=B, s2=A, s5=B, s4=B) with alternative s3 values, and exploring whether low f2 (s2=B) can achieve lower f1 with s1=B or C.
s1=E and s1=D achieve low f2 (~2600-2900). Testing s1=E, s2=B, s4=A with s3=B/D/E and s5 variations to optimize f2 and f1 simultaneously around the low-f2 Pareto boundary.
s2=B controls low f2, while s2=A controls low f1. Combining s1=D/E with s3/s4 variations under s2=B tests lower f2, while s1=C with s2=A and s4=B can improve the balanced knee.
Testing s1=C, s2=A with s3=A, s4=B to find lower f1 and f2 along the left frontier; also testing s1=D/E with s3=A/D, s4=B to explore trade-offs near minimal f2.
Combine low f1 from s1=C, s2=A, s4=B with varied s3 and s5 to push the f1-f2 boundary, and explore s1=A/s1=C with s2=B for lower f2.
s1=C, s2=A with s4=B achieves the lowest f1 values, while s1=D/E with s2=B yields low f2. We test unexplored combinations around s3=C/E/B with different s5 values.
Testing s1=D with s3=B,D,A and s4=A,s5=B achieved low f2. Exploring s1=C with s2=A and s4=B with varied s5, and s1=D/E with potential low f2 combinations.
s1=C, s2=A, s4=B, s5=C yields lowest f1, with s3=C or s3=E. Evaluating s5=E explores potential further f1/f2 reductions, and checking D/E with s3=B/A, s5=C tests low f2 bounds.
Initial exploration across major sites s1, s3, and s5 to identify sensitivity and baseline effects relative to the default evaluated point.
s2=B and s4=B strongly favor low f2, while s2=A and s4=A reduce f1. Testing s1=B with s2=B/s4=B explores whether s1=B can lower f1 without inflating f2.
s2=A drives very low f1 with high f2, while s4 and other factors trade off between them. Test s1=B, s2=A combinations with varying s4/s5 to bridge the Pareto gap and lower both objectives.
s2=A strongly reduces f1 while s2=B optimizes f2. We explore s1=D with s4=A and s5=B/C to see if we can improve upon f2 while maintaining low f1, as well as testing s1=C with s2=A.
Evaluating s2=B combined with s4=A or s5 variations to bridge intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs, and probing s1=D with s3=E/C to minimize f2 below 2624.
Explores combinations around the best f1 region (s1=B/A, s4=A) and searches for lower f2 near the original baseline (s2=B, s4=B) by testing s5 variations.
Testing s1=E with low f1 settings (s3=C/B, s4=A) and examining s3=B with s2=B variants to push the frontier below f2=2800 or achieve lower f1 at low f2.
Combining s1=B, s2=A, s3=C, s4=A which yields minimal f1 with varying s5, while also testing s1=E with s3=B,D and s5=A/C to optimize low f2 frontier.
s1=B, s2=A, s4=A yields the best f1 values, with s5=D yielding the minimum f1 so far. Testing alternative s3 choices (D, A, E) alongside s5=D to push the low-f1 Pareto front.
Evaluating s5=D with low-f1 and balanced s1/s3 settings, as s5=D sharply reduces f2 (e.g. config 45) while s2=B keeps f2 low and s1=E/B balances f1.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values for s1, s3, and s5 to identify main effects on f1 and f2 away from the baseline.
s1=A strongly minimizes f1 while s4=A and s3=B/C favor low f2. Exploring combinations mixing s1=A with low-f2 features to find intermediate Pareto points.
s2=B strongly reduces f2 while s1=A and s3=A reduce f1. Testing s1=A with s2=B and s3=A or other s5 variants could discover optimal trade-offs.
s2=A drives very low f1 while s2=B reduces f2. Pairing s1=A, s2=A with s3=A and s4=A or testing s3=E/D can balance or beat f1=4006 without excessive f2 penalty.
s1=A, s2=A, s4=B yielded the lowest f1 (4006) in config 2. Testing variations with other sites (s5=E, s3=E/C/B) to find lower f2 while preserving minimal f1.
s1=A, s2=A, s4=B yields very low f1 (~3.9k). Combining with s5=E, and testing s3 variants (C, D) or other s5 options may push f1 lower or improve f2.
Test s3=E with s2=A,s4=B,s5=E to seek Pareto improvements in low-f1 region, and explore s3=B with s1=B,s4=A,s5=C or original-like sites with s1=B for lower f2.
s3=E with s5=E yielded the lowest f2 (2304) and s1=A with s4=B yielded very low f1 (~3900). Testing s1/s2/s4/s5 variations around s3=E and s5=E.
Evaluating s1=C and s1=E with s2=B, s3=E, s5=E to test for lower f2 or better trade-offs than s1=D/B, alongside exploring s1=C/D with low-f1 configurations.
Testing s1=E and s1=D with s3=B, s4=B, s5=E to bridge low f1 and lower f2, and trying s1=D with s3=E to explore minimal f2.
Explore diverse orthogonal settings across all sites to quickly map main factor effects against the baseline evaluation.
s1=B and s2=A yielded the lowest f1 (config 3), while s4=B with s5=D/E significantly reduces f2. Combining low-f1 labels with low-f2 components explores balanced Pareto trade-offs.
s2=B strongly reduces f2 while s2=A lowers f1. s4=A lowered f1 in config 3. Testing combinations of s2=B with s4=A and variations in s1/s5 to improve the middle trade-off.
s4=B drives low f2, while s2=A lowers f1 dramatically. Testing combinations of s1=B, s4=B with s5=B/E and varying s3 to optimize the f2 vs f1 frontier.
s1=A/B with s2=B, s4=B, s5=B yielded minimal f2 (2304), while s2=A, s4=A yields minimal f1 (~3708). Testing s3=E with s1=A, s2=B, s5=B to push f2 further.
Test s1=B,A with s2=A, s4=A and varied s3/s5 to push minimal f1, alongside s2=B, s4=B configurations targeting minimal f2.
Testing s5=C on low-f2 architectures (s4=B, s2=B) and exploring potential minimum f1 candidates with s3=D/B, s4=A, and alternative s5 settings.
s1={A,B}, s2=B, s4=B, s5=B achieves the lowest f2, while s2=A, s4=A minimizes f1. Exploring untested s1 or intermediate interactions with s5=D may bridge or push the Pareto boundary.
Testing s1=C with s3=D/E, and s1=B, s2=A with unexplored combinations to find intermediate Pareto points between low f1 and low f2.
Evaluating s1=D with s4=B shows potential improvements in f2, while testing s1=C configurations may uncover better trade-offs in mid-f1/f2 ranges.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to establish main effects and baseline trade-offs relative to the initial evaluated configuration.
s2=B dramatically lowers f1. We test combinations of s2=B with unexplored site values, particularly contrasting s1 choices and checking if s5 or s3 can lower f2 while preserving low f1.
Config 9 reached minimal f1 using s1=D, s3=A, s4=A, s5=E. We test if s2=A can sharply reduce f2 (as seen in config 1) while retaining the extremely low f1 achieved with s1=D.
s2=A and s4=B dramatically lower f2, while s1=D and s3=A yielded the lowest f1 (run 9). Combining s1=D, s3=A with s2=A, s4=B or testing s1=B with s3=A explores low-f1, low-f2 trade-offs.
s2=A and s4=B strongly reduce f2 towards the original baseline. Combining s1=E or s1=D (best f1/f2 trade-offs) with s3=A/D and s5=D tests improvements near the low-f2 Pareto boundary.
s1=E and s1=B yield very low f2 when s2=A and s4=B, while s3=A, s4=A with s2=B yields optimal f1. We test combinations of s1 in {B, E} with s3=A, s4=A and explore s5 variants.
Testing s1=E, s2=A with s5=A and s5=C to optimize f2, and exploring s1=A, s2=B with s3=A to potentially push f1 and f2 boundaries.
s5=C dramatically lowers f2 under s2=A,s4=B, while s2=B,s4=A yields ultra-low f1; we probe s5=C across key s1 labels and s2/s4 regimes.
s5=C consistently minimizes f2 across all contexts. Testing s3=D and s3=B with s5=C and favorable s2/s4 combinations aims to dominate the mid-f1/low-f2 Pareto boundary.
s5=C consistently yields optimal trade-offs. Evaluating s3=C with s4=B and exploring s1=B with s3=B test potential frontier-dominating points near minimal f2.
Probe the search space systematically by varying single sites (s1, s3, s5) relative to the baseline, while adding diverse combinations across other labels to establish initial landscape trends.
Config 5 achieved extremely low f1 (3556) but high f2. We isolate s1=C and combinations of s2/s4 to find configurations with balanced trade-offs between low f1 and lower f2.
s2=B dramatically reduces f1 at the expense of f2, while s4=B with s3=C achieves low f2. Testing combinations of s2=B with s4=B and exploring s1/s3 variants to discover balanced Pareto points.
s3=C and s4=A yield the lowest f1, while s2=A and s4=B offer minimal f2. Testing s1 variants (B, D) with s2=B, s3=C, s4=A and exploring s1=A with other s5 labels to optimize f2.
s3=C yields low f1 or f2. Testing s1 variations and s5=E with s2=A/B and s4=B to improve upon lowest f2 (2368) and investigate lower f1 regions.
Evaluating s1=E, s3=C, s4=B with other s5 labels or s4=A to find better trade-offs near the f2 minimum, and exploring s1=D variants.
s1=E with s3=C, s4=B, s5=C yields the best f2 (2112). Testing unexplored s3 values (D, E) with s1=E and exploring s1=D/B with s2=B to minimize f1 further.
s3=E significantly reduces f2 (observed in #33). Testing s3=E across promising s1 and s2 choices (A, D, and C with s2=B/A) targets improvements along the low-f2 boundary and trade-offs.
Combining s3=E (which yields minimal f2) with s4=A and s2=B tests if ultra-low f1 can pair with s3=E's low-f2 advantage, or improve the low f1 front.
Test s3=E combined with s4=A or s2=B variants, and explore s1=E with s3=E and s4=A to reach potentially lower f2 and non-dominated f1 trade-offs.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to determine the main effects of s1, s2, s3, and s5 compared to the baseline.
s4=A strongly reduces f2, while s1=B drastically cuts f1. Testing s1=B with s4=A and s2=B explores whether ultra-low f1 can pair with lower f2.

Evaluating combinations around high-performing regions: s3=A combined with s2=A yielded the lowest f1 (4006), so varying s4 and s5 around s1=B, s2=A, s3=A explores optimal trade-offs near the extreme f1 boundary.
s2=A drives huge f1 reductions, while s4=B dramatically lowers f1 when paired with s3=A. Testing s3=D and s3=B with s4=B to find balanced knee points.
Combine low f1 from s1=C and s4=B with lower f2 from s3=D and s3=B, testing combinations that improve trade-offs between f1 minimization and lower memory footprint.
s1=C with s2=A, s4=B minimizes f1, while s3=B or D offers lower f2. Exploring variations with s3=B/D and different s5 settings, plus checking s1=C with s2=B for intermediate trade-offs.
Combine top low-f1 features (s1=C, s2=A, s4=B) with untested s3/s5 values (s3=E, s5=D/E) to minimize f1/f2 further, while also probing low-f2 options with s1=E/A and s2=B.
s1=C, s2=A, s4=B, s5=E achieved Pareto optimality; testing other s3 choices (s3=B, s3=A, s3=E) with s5=E, plus exploring s1=A and s1=D variants with low f2 features.
s5=E consistently reduces f2 across regions. Testing s5=E with s2=B variants (like s1=A,B,C, s3=B,D) explores lowering f2 further in the low-f2 regime, and tests unexplored combinations.
Evaluating s5=E with low-f2 drivers (s2=B, s4=A) alongside s1=A and s3=D to target ultra-low f2, plus testing s1=C with s3=C or s3=D/E combinations.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to probe main effects and establish baselines against the original reference.
Combine s1=A and s3=B (which yielded low f1 in #2) with s4=A and s5=B (low f2 in #1, #6) to explore favorable trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Investigate the impact of s5=A and s4 variations with s2=B to pinpoint low-f1 drivers, and test s1=B with s5=A to push the low-f2 boundary.
s4=A yields dramatically lower f2 (~2.6-3.1k vs ~16k). In #2, s1=A, s2=B, s3=B, s5=A gave f1=3809 with s4=B. Testing s4=A with this base may achieve low f1 while dropping f2 significantly.
s5=C dramatically lowered f2 in config 21 without harming f1. Testing s5=C across low-f1 setups (s2=B, s4=B) and low-f2 setups (s1=D/B, s4=A) to expand both extremes of the Pareto frontier.
s5=C consistently lowers f2 across all contexts. Testing s5=C with s3=C, s3=E, and s1 variations balances low f1 and low f2.
Investigate s5=C combined with untested s3 settings (D, E) under low-f1 (s2=B, s4=B) and low-f2 (s2=A, s4=A) regimes to improve extreme and intermediate Pareto points.
s5=C consistently minimizes f2. s1=D/B with s2=A achieve the lowest f2, while s3=C, s4=B with s1=A, s2=B yields low f1. Testing unexplored interactions with s5=C and s4=B.
s5=C consistently minimizes f2. s1=E gives lowest f1 for s2=A, while s1=B gives lowest f2. Testing s1=E with s3=A and s1=B with s3=D explores new potential Pareto extrema.
s1=B and s2=B combined with s3=D/E or s1=E with s3=B/D offer potential Pareto improvements in f2 minimizing and trade-offs.
Exploration of primary sites s1, s3, and s5 via coordinate perturbations around baseline to gauge main effects.
Combine beneficial sites: s5=A dramatically improves f2, s1=C reduces f1, and s2=B/s4=A drastically lowers f1. Testing combinations of s1=C/A with s5=A and exploring s2=B variants.
Combining s1=C (low f1) and s5=A (low f2) with s2=B and s4=A to seek extreme low f1, while exploring untested levels of s3 and s5.
s1=A and s2=B combined with s4=A produced the best f1 (config 14), while s3=C improves f1 with low f2 penalty. Testing s1=A, s2=B, s3=C, s4=A with s5=A and exploring s1=E.
Test remaining unobserved s3 levels (E) and s5 variations combined with the best-performing low-f1 backbone (s1=A, s2=B, s4=A) and explore low-f2 interactions with s3=D/E.
Test s1=C with s4=A and s3 variations for low f1/intermediate f2, explore s3=A interactions where s4 is inactive, and test s1=D/E with s2=B to push f1 lower.
s1=D and s1=E remain unexplored under the high-performing s2=B, s4=A branch, while testing s5 variations with s3=C/A could yield better trade-offs near the Pareto boundary.
Test s1=E and s1=D with s3=D and other combinations around the ultra-low f1 frontier, while checking intermediate s2=B configurations to map Pareto-optimal trade-offs.
Combining s1=D/E with s3=A and s4=A or testing s1=D with s3=A/C to uncover superior f1 without excessive f2 penalty, as s1=D/E minimizes f1 dramatically.
Evaluate combinations with low f2 from s1=C/s2=A or ultra-low f1 from s1=D/E, s2=B, s4=A to push Pareto extremes.
